resources.string:
The connection could not be completed. Your local records are still on this device.

Check your internet connection and Google account, then try again. Try Again returns to file setup, where you can choose a file with Google Picker or create a new one.

If setup was interrupted, some Paninda worksheets or a newly created file may already exist. Review the selected file before retrying.

Both this device and the file contain changes that cannot be combined automatically. Neither copy has been replaced.\n\nReview the file and keep this device’s records. You can reconnect to the original file or create a separate file from your local records. Conflict suggestions are also available in Settings.

The file does not match Paninda’s data contract. Nothing was imported into this device.\n\nRestore the (Paninda) worksheet names, row-1 headers and valid field values, then retry. Keep a copy of the file before making repairs. You can also create a separate file using the records on this device.

Google could not authorize this installation. The project owner needs to enable the Drive, Sheets and Picker APIs and register this app’s package and signing certificate as an Android OAuth client.\n\nYour local records are safe. Retry after the Cloud Console setup is complete.
Google denied access. Check the selected account, requested permissions, OAuth test-user list and enabled APIs. Your local records are preserved.\n\nRetry to request authorization again.

This file is no longer accessible. It may have been deleted or its sharing permissions may have changed. Local records are preserved.\n\nRestore access, or disconnect in Settings and choose another file in Google Picker.
Google’s request limit was reached. Your local changes are still pending. Wait a moment, then try again.

Google may have received the upload, but its result could not be confirmed. Local records and pending changes have been kept.\n\nReview the file, then retry sync. Paninda will read both copies again before continuing. Avoid editing the file while a sync is running.

This file already contains data and is missing some worksheets that Paninda needs.

Proceed adds the missing (Paninda) worksheets inside this same file. Existing data and other worksheets will be kept. Paninda will only use its own worksheets for app records.

Worksheets to add:
Select one Google Sheets file that you can edit. Files in the trash, read-only files and other formats cannot be connected.
